text: Bùi Ngọc Tấn's A Tale for 2000 was published in February 2000 by Thanh Niên Publishing House. On 16 March 2000, the Ministry of Culture and Information ordered the book withdrawn and destroyed.
meta_description: A Tale for 2000 by Bùi Ngọc Tấn: published in February 2000, withdrawn and destroyed on a Ministry of Culture and Information order in March.
